narr: An upper level trough had moved into the Central Plains. An upper level disturbance associated with the upper trough moved over West Texas. This helped increase lift over the area. Low-level moisture was also fairly high across the area. These conditions resulted in storms that produced severe wind gusts and flash flooding across parts of West Texas.
ev: Heavy rain resulted in flash flooding in the City of Midland. There were multiple stalled vehicles reported in flash flooding at the intersections of North Loop 250 and Lancashire, North Garfield and Castleford, and Midland Drive and Wadley. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.

Heavy rain resulted in flash flooding in north Odessa. There was a road closure at the intersection of Andrews Highway and 87th Street in north Odessa due to flooding. The cost of damage is a very rough estimate.
